---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<img src="images/main_logo.png" class="centered-image">

## Network Graph
Nodes currently connected to GB7CAM

<div style="padding:10px;font-family:sans-serif;">
  <input id="filter" placeholder="Filter node (e.g. GB7FCI)" style="padding:6px;width:240px;">
</div>

<div id="network" style="height: 90vh; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #ffffff;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

let nodes, edges, network;
let fullData = null;

/* ----------------------------
   NODE NORMALISATION
---------------------------- */
function normalizeId(id) {
  if (!id) return id;
  if (id.startsWith("GB7CAM")) return "GB7CAM";
  return id;
}

/* ----------------------------
   NODE TYPE COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function nodeColor(id) {

  if (id === "GB7CAM") return "#ff6b6b"; // core

  if (id.startsWith("GB7")) return "#4dabf7"; // BBS/mailbox
  if (id.startsWith("MB7")) return "#20c997"; // data nodes

  if (/^(G[0-9]|M[0-9]|2E|2M)/.test(id)) return "#ffd43b"; // UK personals

  return "#adb5bd";
}

/* ----------------------------
   PORT COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ca02c"; // RF
    case "2": return "#ffbf00"; // telnet
    case "3": return "#1f77b4"; // AXIP
    default: return "#999999";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH (quality)
---------------------------- */
function width(q) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, (q || 50) / 40));
}

/* ----------------------------
   ACTIVE EDGE RULE
---------------------------- */
function isBroken(e) {
  return (e.quality === 0);
}

/* ----------------------------
   BUILD GRAPH
---------------------------- */
function build(data) {

  const nodeMap = new Map();

  // nodes
  (data.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    const id = normalizeId(n.id);

  let label = id;

  // only your node is simplified
    if (id === "GB7CAM") {
      label = "GB7CAM";
    } else if (n.alias) {
      label = id + "\n" + n.alias;
    }

    nodeMap.set(id, {
      id,
      label: label,
      color: nodeColor(id),
      title: n.alias || ""   // optional hover info
    });
  });

  // ensure endpoints exist
  (data.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    const s = normalizeId(e.source);
    const t = normalizeId(e.target);

    if (!nodeMap.has(s)) nodeMap.set(s, { id: s, label: s, color: nodeColor(s) });
    if (!nodeMap.has(t)) nodeMap.set(t, { id: t, label: t, color: nodeColor(t) });
  });

  nodes = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  edges = new vis.DataSet(
    (data.edges || []).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: normalizeId(e.source),
      to: normalizeId(e.target),
      label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",
      width: width(e.quality),
      arrows: "to",
      color: { color: portColor(e.port), highlight: "#000" },
      dashes: isBroken(e)
    }))
  );

  render();
}

/* ----------------------------
   RENDER
---------------------------- */
function render() {

  const container = document.getElementById("network");

  network = new vis.Network(container, {
    nodes,
    edges
  }, {
    physics: {
      stabilization: true,
      barnesHut: {
        gravitationalConstant: -9000,
        springLength: 140
      }
    },
    nodes: {
      shape: "dot",
      size: 12,
      font: { color: "#222" }
    },
    edges: {
      smooth: { type: "dynamic" }
    }
  });

  setupFilter();
}

/* ----------------------------
   FILTER WITH +1 NEIGHBOUR HOPE
---------------------------- */
function applyFilter() {

  const q = document.getElementById("filter").value.trim().toUpperCase();

  if (!q) {
    nodes.forEach(n => nodes.update({ id: n.id, hidden: false }));
    edges.forEach(e => edges.update({ id: e.id, hidden: false }));
    return;
  }

  const matchNodes = new Set();

  nodes.forEach(n => {
    if (n.id.includes(q)) matchNodes.add(n.id);
  });

  // +1 hop expansion
  edges.forEach(e => {
    if (matchNodes.has(e.from) || matchNodes.has(e.to)) {
      matchNodes.add(e.from);
      matchNodes.add(e.to);
    }
  });

  nodes.forEach(n => {
    nodes.update({
      id: n.id,
      hidden: !matchNodes.has(n.id)
    });
  });

  edges.forEach(e => {
    edges.update({
      id: e.id,
      hidden: !(matchNodes.has(e.from) && matchNodes.has(e.to))
    });
  });
}

/* ----------------------------
   FILTER EVENT
---------------------------- */
function setupFilter() {
  document.getElementById("filter")
    .addEventListener("input", applyFilter);
}

/* ----------------------------
   LOAD
---------------------------- */
fetch(API)
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => {
    fullData = data;
    build(data);
  });

</script>
